title: Meet My Family
source_credit: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English Level 1 Lesson 12. Official human conversation audio and corresponding dialogue. WorldVoice is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Hello! Washington, D.C. has many beautiful parks. In fact, this park reminds me of my home very far away.
dialogue.translation_ar: مرحبًا! في واشنطن حدائق جميلة كثيرة. وهذه الحديقة تذكرني ببيتي البعيد.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I'm thinking about my family. I'm feeling homesick.
dialogue.translation_ar: أفكر في عائلتي. أشعر بالحنين إلى الوطن.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Do you want to talk about it?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: This is my mother and this is my father. They are rodeo clowns.
dialogue.translation_ar: هذه أمي وهذا أبي. إنهما مهرجان في عروض الروديو.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: They make jokes at a rodeo. They make people laugh.
dialogue.translation_ar: يمزحون في عروض الروديو ويضحكون الناس.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Who is that woman in the picture?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: That is my Aunt Lavender. She is my mom's sister. She loves gardening and makes spoons.
dialogue.translation_ar: هذه خالتي لافندر، أخت أمي. تحب البستنة وتصنع الملاعق.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Oh! This is my Uncle John. He is my father's brother.
dialogue.translation_ar: أوه، هذا عمي جون، أخو أبي.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: He's a chicken farmer. And makes guitars. He's awesome, and I'm his favorite niece.
dialogue.translation_ar: يربي الدجاج ويصنع آلات الغيتار. إنه رائع وأنا ابنة أخيه المفضلة.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: They are my cousins. They are my Uncle John's daughter and son.
dialogue.translation_ar: هما ابنا عمي، ابنة العم جون وابنه.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: They raise sheep and make sweaters.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: Thanks for showing me your family photos. Your family is very different.
dialogue.translation_ar: شكرًا لأنك أريتني صور عائلتك. عائلتك مميزة جدًا.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I do feel better. Thanks for listening. I have many more photos!
dialogue.translation_ar: أشعر بتحسن فعلًا. شكرًا لاستماعك. لدي صور أخرى كثيرة!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Washington, DC is my new home. But I like remembering my old home, too.
dialogue.translation_ar: واشنطن هي موطني الجديد، لكنني أحب تذكر موطني القديم أيضًا.

questions.question: What helps Anna remember her family?
